input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic field service engineering desk reported a minor, non-recurrent complete atrioventricular block-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The bedside monitor log and the cloud-side classifier log disagree on whether the irregularity met the complete atrioventricular block detection threshold, an unresolved discordance. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.

risk_report.rationale: The incident involves a minor, non-recurrent complete atrioventricular block with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The disagreement between the bedside monitor log and the cloud-side classifier log regarding whether the irregularity met the detection threshold is unresolved. This may trigger obligations under EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.4 — Minimum IT security requirements, as well as Article 83(1)-(2) — Post-market surveillance system of the manufacturer. The incident requires further investigation to ensure that the software development lifecycle and cybersecurity principles are being followed.
